findings.title: MFA policy contradiction: every Sales user is forced into mandatory MFA
findings.remediation_action: Removed `security_event.read` from Sales; made it ALL-only (no OWN). Canonical sensitivity classification (`sensitivity_class`) in the code registry, with a registry rule that seeded SALES holds no sensitive permission. Sensitive permissions are effective only with MFA (MFA-012), suspended when MFA is absent, removed or reset. `authz_version` covers MFA-state changes and sessions are checked uncached. Sales MFA optional by default. Negative tests for Sales security-event access.
findings.validation_evidence_required: 12 §4.3 access tests (Sales 403 incl. self), 12 §4.4 sensitivity registry + activation + propagation tests, 12 §4.5 MFA policy test

findings.title: Account recovery weakens MFA: password-only enrollment after an MFA reset or a policy change
findings.remediation_action: Enrollment only via four two-proof paths (MFA-014); login with MFA required but no factor emails an enrollment link and returns no token. Recovery = password re-entry + recovery code → restricted RECOVERY session (allow-list, 15 min, no refresh) → re-enrollment with code rotation → cooling-off; other sessions revoked; notification to the verified email. Admin reset: `user.mfa.reset`, step-up, G3/G9/G11, dual control for privileged targets, Founder via two Founders or break-glass with two IAM custodians; enrollment link to the target's verified email. Full event catalog.
findings.validation_evidence_required: 12 §4.5 enrollment-proof, recovery, cooling-off and admin-reset tests; 12 §4.4 dual-control and break-glass tests

findings.title: Stronger accounts can be taken over or disabled through non-sensitive user-administration endpoints
findings.remediation_action: Retired `user.update`; granular permissions (`user.profile.update`, `user.email.change`, `user.status.manage`, `user.role.manage`, `user.permission.manage`, `user.mfa.reset`, `user.mfa.require`, `user.founder.manage`). Closed profile-only DTOs. Proposed-email workflow. G9 extended to all account-control actions; G3 extended to self-deactivation; G4 invariants I1/I2 under the write lock plus nightly check; G11 Founder protection via `protection_level`; G12 dual control; break-glass. FINAL: dual-control eligibility defect addressed by N-01.
findings.validation_evidence_required: 12 §4.4 mass-assignment, G1–G12, Founder and last-administrator concurrency tests; 12 §4.5 email-change tests

findings.title: Public-intake idempotency contract is contradictory and not implementable as specified
findings.remediation_action: Request fingerprint (JCS SHA-256) stored with the key; idempotency lookup moved before Turnstile (after rate limiting); single behavior stated in 04 §5.1 and 08 §2.8.
findings.validation_evidence_required: 12 §4.6 idempotency tests (spent Turnstile token replay; key reuse 422; lookup-before-CAPTCHA)

findings.title: Public-intake non-success paths can silently drop or misreport genuine enquiries

findings.title: SENSITIVE_ACTION on reads is self-contradictory

FINAL: re-review found a regression (broadened rule 3), corrected by N-02 without changing the purge order.
findings.validation_evidence_required: 12 §4.1 purge-ordering test with foreign_keys=ON on both engines

findings.title: Founder dual-control approver eligibility is contradictory, and Founder powers can be granted outside the Founder workflow
findings.remediation_action: Canonical Founder-governance workflow in 06 §7.2 (single authoritative definition). Founder = protection_level FOUNDER + FOUNDER role (I3). The FOUNDER role and `user.founder.manage` have grant_path FOUNDER_WORKFLOW_ONLY. G13 rejects every generic role, permission or role-definition path (grant, deny, copy, edit). One eligibility rule: requester and approver are Founders with effective user.founder.manage, step-up, re-checked at request, approval and execution; approver ≠ requester ≠ target; one approval; duplicate → 409. Single-Founder mode: a custodian who is a distinct human is the second principal. Full break-glass: two distinct-human custodians. Bootstrap creates only the first Founder ever. One open Founder request per target. Invariants I1–I3 under the write lock. Approval-policy changes have no runtime API.
findings.validation_evidence_required: TD-G cases G1–G14 (both engines); TG-07 targeted independent verification

findings.title: Regression: broadened conformance rule 3 rejects unregistered FK-less GUID columns

Rule 3 now fails any unregistered ID-like FK-less column and any registered column with the wrong type or missing CHECK, index or documentation. No global relaxation. Purge order unchanged (F-07 not reintroduced).
